items.exampleEn: The new stadium has forty thousand seats.
items.exampleZh: 新的體育場有四萬個座位。

items.exampleEn: My dad is a slow runner, but he never stops.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸跑得很慢，但他從不停下來。

items.exampleEn: These skates are too small for me now.
items.exampleZh: 這雙溜冰鞋我現在穿太小了。

items.exampleEn: The team is ready for the next challenge.
items.exampleZh: 這支隊伍已經準備好迎接下一個挑戰。

items.exampleEn: This sport needs speed and strength.
items.exampleZh: 這項運動需要速度和力量。

items.exampleEn: She won a singing competition last year.
items.exampleZh: 她去年贏了一場歌唱比賽。

items.exampleEn: The athletes ran around the track.
My father plays golf on Sundays.
items.exampleZh: 我爸爸星期天會打高爾夫球。

items.sentenceEn: The stadium was full of happy fans.
items.sentenceZh: 體育場裡擠滿了開心的球迷。

items.audioEn: The competition starts at nine at the city stadium.
items.audioZh: 比賽九點在市立體育場開始。

items.sentenceEn: Running up the hill was a real challenge.
items.sentenceZh: 跑上那座山丘真是一大挑戰。

items.sentenceEn: My uncle is a great golf player.
items.sentenceZh: 我叔叔是很厲害的高爾夫球選手。

items.stemEn: The fastest ____ crossed the line first.
items.stemZh: 跑最快的跑者最先衝過終點線。

items.stemEn: You need great ____ to carry this heavy box.
items.stemZh: 要搬這個重箱子需要很大的力氣。

items.passageEn: Last month, our city had a big sports competition at the new stadium. Athletes came from all over the country. My friend Kevin was one of the runners. It was a real challenge for him because the weather was very hot, but he finished third. The next weekend, I rented a pair of skates and went skating with him.
items.passageZh: 上個月，我們市在新的體育場舉辦了一場大型運動比賽，運動員來自全國各地。我的朋友 Kevin 是參賽的跑者之一。天氣非常熱，對他來說是一大挑戰，不過他還是跑了第三名。隔週週末，我租了一雙溜冰鞋，跟他一起去溜冰。

questions.questionZh: 這場比賽為什麼對 Kevin 是一大挑戰？

referenceEn: She wants to be an athlete.
She wants to become an athlete.
rubricZh: 「想成為」可寫例如 wants to be、wants to become

items.promptZh: 學一種新語言是很大的挑戰。
referenceEn: Learning a new language is a big challenge.
It is a big challenge to learn a new language.
rubricZh: 用 challenge 表示「挑戰」（例如 a big challenge）
主詞可寫，例如 Learning…、It is…to learn… 等
